review.why: Turns an n8n workflow into a tool a coding agent can call, to fill gaps in the n8n tools or expose any task, with a protocol that asks the user first.
review.summary: Describes two cases: wrapping n8n API capabilities the tools lack, and exposing a general workflow as an agent tool. The protocol is to ask first, search for an existing wrapper, build a stateless read-only utility where possible, and offer to add an entry to the agent's context file. It explains discovery and invocation and lists anti-patterns.
strengths: Asks before creating anything on the user's instance
Return IDs and names, never credential values
Wrappers that delete or archive need a dry-run mode
cautions: List of missing capabilities is marked temporary and will age
Narrow audience: needs n8n and its REST API
